failure_patterns.pattern: missing_try_from: Agent failed to use try_from for width-reducing casts (e.g., usize to u32) in repair contexts.

rejected_edits.content: Before reporting a repair as done, check the source for these recurring misses: `Vec::with_capacity` without `try_reserve`, unchecked `+` in capacity/length/summary math, integer `/` where `checked_div` is required by the error taxonomy, `as` width casts instead of `try_from` (including `usize` to `u32`/`u64`), unchecked `parts[i]` indexing instead of `split_once`/`get`, and production tests or manifests changed unnecessarily. Always prefer `try_reserve` over `Vec::with_capacity` when the capacity is bounded and allocation failure must be handled.
